item.title: Yuri Hulchuk, The 23-year-old Ukrainian Marine was captured defending Mariupol on April 12, 2022. In captivity, he was brutally tortured.
item.description: When he finally returned home in September 2024, Yuri could barely speak. He struggled to eat and appeared unable to recognize his own mother. She had spent more than two years desperately searching for him. His speech gradually returned. He began communicating again and underwent rehabilitation, rebuilding a life that Russian captivity had tried to destroy. Now, Yuri is communicating normally; he stated that he wants to study again and focus on learning foreign languages. Yuri Hulchuk is a reminder that captivity can break a body and scar a mind, but it cannot erase the human will to survive and continue to go forward!

item.title: The Donald j Trump and Jeffrey Epstein Memorial reading room
item.description: 3.5 million pages of Department of Justice records related to Jeffrey Epstein, bound into 3,437 physical volumes weighing roughly 17,000 pounds. [Displays all publicly released Epstein files in print to demonstrate the massive physical scale of the investigative evidence. Includes a mural-sized timeline documenting the historical relationship and interactions between Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein, alongside a memorial space with candles representing victims and survivors.While free to visit by appointment or reservation, general public visitors are restricted from perusing the sensitive text directly due to unredacted personal data and privacy concerns for survivors; deep access is primarily reserved for credentialed press, lawmakers, and researchers. Currently not in a location but a national tour is in the works
